about: MOSHI Table 3 vs Table 17 probe queries. a1-a8 are copied verbatim from experiments/phase8/table_retrieval.py (written by the assistant after inspecting the tables; not an independent test set). The 8 table-set questions about T3/T17 (t05-t08, t29-t32) are read from eval/phase7/table_question_set.json at run time. 'exclusion' marks queries that identify the table by what it lacks; 'mentions_mushra_to_exclude' marks those that name MUSHRA in order to exclude it.

queries.question: In the Moshi Mimi codec ablation that includes human MUSHRA judgments, which configuration has the highest MUSHRA score?
Which Mimi codec ablation in the Moshi paper reports MUSHRA alongside ABX, VisQOL and MOSNet?
In the Mimi ablation with MUSHRA scores, what MUSHRA does the configuration without a Transformer in the decoder get?
What MUSHRA score does the Mimi ablation report for the configuration with WavLM distillation but no split quantizer?
In the additional appendix ablation on the Mimi codec, what ABX error does the configuration without any of the five components get?
In the Moshi appendix's additional ablation on the Mimi codec, what VisQOL does the configuration with only a Transformer in the encoder get?
In the additional ablation on the Mimi codec, which configuration with quantization rate only is listed, and what is its MOSNet?
In the extended Mimi codec ablation without MUSHRA, what ABX does the configuration with Transformers in both encoder and decoder but no quantization rate get?
